599:t_115:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Why do you give up like that?! You haven't even tried anything yet!」

599:t_115:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「There are things that are impossible no matter how you struggle. You beating me is one of them.」

599:t_115:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Then I'll defeat you and prove that's wrong!」

599:t_115:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And I'll make you help us, too! All of humanity will stand up to that future of despair together!」

599:t_116:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even you, a stranger to this world, would denounce me...」

599:t_116:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「What you're doing is nothing but running away! I... don't want to accept something like that!」

599:t_116:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Quite the words from a temporary guest.」

599:t_116:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... won't run away...! I'm living in this world now, too!」

599:t_117:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The time has finally come to settle this, fake $$赤い彗星$$!」

599:t_117:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That name has become mine, the one who bears the feelings of the Spacenoids... no, of all Earth's humanity.」

599:t_117:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Quit acting like you represent everyone! At least I have no intention of accepting you, a man who can't hold any hope!」

599:t_117:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What $$ティファ$$ and I want is a future overflowing with hope! I won't let you, who shut it off on your own, do whatever you want with this world!」

599:t_117:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So this boy, too, has had his soul guided by a $$ガンダム$$...」

599:t_118:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You don't understand the weight of a human life, so you have no power to lead the world!」

599:t_118:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And do you understand the responsibility of one who shoulders the world?」

599:t_118:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I've seen up close someone who always faces that! I can't sense the sorrow or the resolve that person has in you!」

599:t_118:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「All you're doing is forcing your own logic on other people and the world! I won't accept someone like that!」

599:t_118:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I will simply remove you from the world I lead. Prepare yourself.」

599:t_119:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The time has come to settle our fate, $$アムロ$$.」

599:t_119:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop imitating $$シャア$$, $$フロンタル$$! If you're going to fight, fight with your own will!」

599:t_119:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Heh... you're right. I have already surpassed $$シャア・アズナブル$$ as the true $$赤い彗星$$.」

599:t_119:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I will prove it by defeating you.」

599:t_119:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A man who can't recognize himself without using others as stepping stones. How pitiful!」

599:t_119:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I can never accept that a man like that has surpassed my lifelong rival!」

599:t_120:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're coming for me, $$カミーユ$$!」

599:t_120:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't say my name so casually! To me, you're nothing but an enemy to be beaten!」

599:t_120:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You would ignore my existence?」

599:t_120:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is that your inferiority complex toward the Colonel! Then you do have some human side, after all!」

599:t_120:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「As expected of the man $$シャア$$ took an interest in. You provoke me the same way...」

599:t_120:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Very well, $$カミーユ$$. I will show you, too, that I have surpassed $$シャア$$.」

599:t_120:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're conscious of the Colonel to the very end! That's your limit, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

599:t_121:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Two $$ガンダム$$s joining together to defy me...! Me, the vessel of humanity's consensus...!」

599:t_121:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A vessel...! Even if someone is man-made, a person can't become something like that!」

599:t_121:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Spit out what's under that mask! $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

599:t_121:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then... I will simply take you on...!」

599:t_121:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't think threats like that can stop us... stop humanity!」

599:t_121:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It is no threat. I always carry out what I say I will do.」

599:t_121:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$フロンタル$$'s pressure keeps growing...!?」

599:t_121:8.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Come, $$ガンダム$$! Beyond this battle lies humanity's future!」

599:t_122:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you have a factor of $$シャア・アズナブル$$ in you, why do you stop humanity from moving forward!」

599:t_122:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Because I know that despair awaits there. In that sense, you, an $$イノベイター$$, are also someone who should be eliminated.」

599:t_122:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「Words like that can't stop the future!」

599:t_122:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then try overcoming me. I do take pride in having a certain amount of power myself.」

599:t_122:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If you cannot beat even me, you will never be able to advance any further.」

599:t_122:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「You don't need to tell us! We will break through you... the one who blocks the future!」

599:t_123:1.en:
$$シン$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! You, who dragged $$プラント$$ in and started a war, will be fought by me!」

599:t_123:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Peace lies beyond this war. In that sense, you who resist me can be called the very obstacle to peace.」

599:t_123:3.en:
$$シン$$
「There's no way the world you lead is peaceful!」

599:t_123:4.en:
$$シン$$
「No fighting doesn't mean peace! A world that steals the happiness of the people living in it is just as hateful as war!」

599:t_124:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You, the dream of the $$コーディネイター$$s, can also be called a vessel that gathers people's feelings, just as I am.」

599:t_124:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You could take the place of $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$ and $$ラクス・クライン$$ and become the symbol that leads $$プラント$$.」

599:t_124:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「You want me... to play the same role as you?」

599:t_124:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Exactly. It is the shortcut to bringing peace to space and Earth.」

599:t_124:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「I... won't become something like that. Because a person's feelings belong to that person.」

599:t_124:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You deny my... no, your own existence?」

599:t_124:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'm me. I'm not living to fulfill someone else's wish!」

599:t_124:8.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll fight you with my own will! To stop your twisted wish!」

599:t_125:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

599:t_125:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Dragging out an anachronistic machine like that is your limit!」

599:t_125:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「A vessel that gathers humanity's consensus, a new $$赤い彗星$$... An existence that is nothing but an image dressed up in pleasant-sounding words... That is you.」

599:t_125:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You mean to call me a sham?」

599:t_125:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「A man whose logic runs ahead of everything, who knows neither the weight of human life nor of human feelings, cannot shoulder the world!」

599:t_125:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「And certainly not if he would lose to a small fry who threw away the name of the $$赤い彗星$$!」

599:t_125:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Very well, $$シャア$$! Then I will prove my own strength by defeating you!」

599:t_125:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! Know that that very thinking already exposes how small your vessel is!」

599:t_126:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even the Iron Lady is only a woman in the end.」

599:t_126:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That kind of vulgar talk is more likeable than your usual empty, flowery words.」

599:t_126:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Say what you like. I will purge you with my own hands, you who betrayed $$ジオン$$.」

599:t_126:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It is you who betrayed $$ジオン$$... the god of the Spacenoids, $$フロンタル$$!」

599:t_126:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You who stop the time of humanity that went into space seeking a future are the very enemy of the people of space! Prepare yourself, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

599:t_127:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've got you, $$フル・フロンタル$$! I'm bringing you down here!」

599:t_127:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! How pathetic, letting yourself be talked around by $$シャア$$!」

599:t_127:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't get it wrong! I didn't go over to that man's side!」

599:t_127:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'm a member of $c now! My fight is my own, and the Colonel has nothing to do with it!」

599:t_127:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ギュネイ$$... So you've grown up a bit...!」
